text.p: D&N Financial Corp said Monday it reinstated its dividend and declared a quarterly payout of $0.05 a share, payable October 10 to shareholders of record on September 26.
A D&N spokeswoman said the company paid its last dividend of $0.075 a share in October 1990. It discontinued its dividend because of the need to conserve capital.
The spokeswoman said D&N intends to pay a quarterly dividend going forward.

The company said it also completed the preferred stock offering by its D&N Capital Corp subsidiary. With the over-allotment fully exercised, a total of 1.21 million, 9.0 percent noncumulative exchangeable preferred stock shares were sold.
The preferred stock raised $29.1 million of capital for D&N Bank.
D&N Financial has 48 financial services offices throughout Michigan.
